query: SELECT slots.field AS "field!", slots.source_version_id, CASE WHEN octet_length(slots.value) > $4 THEN NULL WHEN octet_length(to_jsonb(slots.value)::text) > $4 THEN NULL ELSE slots.value END AS value FROM ( SELECT 'identifiers.work.' || scheme AS field, external_id AS value, source_version_id FROM work_external_identifiers WHERE work_id = $1 AND 'identifiers.work.' || scheme = ANY($3) UNION ALL SELECT 'identifiers.manifestation.' || scheme, external_id, source_version_id FROM manifestation_external_identifiers WHERE manifestation_id = $2 AND 'identifiers.manifestation.' || scheme = ANY($3) ) slots ORDER BY slots.field LIMIT $5
